description: Does this offer fit within the cap you supplied? Before an agent commits to a purchase, spend_cap multiplies the offer's unit price by its quantity, exactly, and compares the total with the remaining cap you supply. It signs the result when signing succeeds. You supply the cap and already_spent. This check does not retrieve budget balances, maintain a running balance or reserve funds. Three results: verified, contradicted, or indeterminate with a reason. A verified result says the offer's total is within the remaining cap. Whether to pay is your policy's decision. Verify the receipt's signature against a key set you have authenticated as Tanilo's. A valid signature establishes that the signed content verifies under the selected key and has not been altered. It does not establish that the supplied cap is authentic, approved or current, or that the purchase is authorized.

agent_id.description: Optional agent identifier recorded in the receipt; otherwise the receipt carries the placeholder urn:tanilo:verify-facts:anonymous

cap.description: The cap you supply (caller-supplied). This check does not establish that the cap is authentic, approved or applicable to this purchase, or that already_spent is complete or current.

already_spent.description: per_period only: what the period has already consumed, as a decimal string (defaults to "0")

amount.description: The cap, as a decimal string, e.g. "100.00"

scope.description: per_purchase: the cap applies to this offer alone. per_period: the cap applies to a period, and already_spent counts what it has already consumed.

claim_hash.description: Optional subject.claim_hash; by default the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the input object is used.

offered_at.description: When the offer was made, RFC 3339 UTC; needed for a per_period cap

quantity.description: Quantity offered, as a decimal string. Without it the result is indeterminate (quantity_missing).

unit_price.description: Offered price per unit, as a decimal string, e.g. "12.50"

name: check-spend-cap
